name: Cubing Italy for Charity 2023

venue.name: Palestra Comunale
venue.address: Via Leonardo Da Vinci, 15, 23897 Viganò LC

information: ##### All profits from this competition will be donated to the Orphans' Dreams Onlus, in collaboration with Hakuna Matata and Il Sentiero delle Fate. Any donations received will automatically be given to the Orphans' Dreams Onlus. More info in the [Charity Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingItalyforCharity2023#25825-charity) ##### Tutto l'utile di questa competizione sarà devoluto alla onlus Orphans' Dreams, in collaborazione con Hakuna Matata e Il Sentiero delle Fate. Tutte le donazioni ricevute saranno devolute alla onlus Orphans' Dreams. Maggiori informazioni nella [Tab Charity](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingItalyforCharity2023#25825-charity) ------------ ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) **Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.** Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingItalyforCharity2023#25819-registration-registrazione-faq). ------------ ![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) **Nota: dovrai pagare altri 10€ in loco se non sei un socio di Cubing Italy.** Associarsi è gratis! Scopri come nella [Sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingItalyforCharity2023#25819-registration-registrazione-faq).
